objectives: Students will learn to examine the pathophysiology and causes of neurological diseases and how this information is used to develop therapeutic strategies.
Students will learn to assimilate the literature about our understanding of disease mechanisms for individual diseases covered in this course.
Students will understand the broad concepts of functional deficits and the mechanisms involved in each neurological disease covered in the course.
Students will investigate, analyze, synthesize, and write knowledgeably and coherently on one neurological disease covered in the course in a written course report.
